jp_sentences: 土曜日、村のおまつりに行った。
空は真っ赤で、まるで写真のようだった。
弟は父のまねが上手で、まるで父が歌っているようだった。
全く知らない人と、あまいまめを食べた。
こんな夜は、ますます好きになる。
来年もこのおまつりに来たい。
jp: 土曜日、村のおまつりに行った。空は真っ赤で、まるで写真のようだった。弟は父のまねが上手で、まるで父が歌っているようだった。全く知らない人と、あまいまめを食べた。こんな夜は、ますます好きになる。来年もこのおまつりに来たい。
translation_pt: No sábado fui ao festival do vilarejo. O céu estava todo vermelho, parecia até uma foto. Meu irmão mais novo imita bem o meu pai, parecia até que era o meu pai cantando. Comi doce de feijão com uma pessoa que eu não conhecia de nada. Eu gosto cada vez mais de noites assim. Ano que vem quero voltar a esse festival.
translation_en: On Saturday I went to the village festival. The sky was bright red, just like a photograph. My little brother does a good impression of our father, it was just like our father singing. I ate sweet beans with someone I didn't know at all. I like nights like this more and more. Next year I want to come to this festival again.

grammar_target_label.pt-BR: まるで〜のようだ (tal qual), sobre o bloco de vocabulário em ま (祭り, 真似, 豆, 真っ赤, 全く, 益々)
grammar_target_label.en: marude ~no you da (just like), over the ma- vocabulary block (matsuri, mane, mame, makka, mattaku, masumasu)

grammar_licensed: よう / なる are the grammar tails of gram:gp-77 (まるで〜のようだ) and gram:naru; Sudachi links them to the homograph vocab records 用 (vocab:1546200) and 生る (vocab:1611000), and BOTH are already inside this lesson's cumulative_known_set, so the gate is unaffected
